HP Victus 15-FA2013DX Core i5-13420H RTX 3050 Gaming Laptop

Elevate your gaming and everyday productivity with the HP Victus 15-FA2013DX. Powered by the high-performance 13th Gen Intel Core i5-13420H processor and 8GB of responsive RAM, this laptop is designed to deliver smooth gameplay, efficient multitasking, and snappy performance for students and creators alike. Equipped with the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (6GB GDDR6), you can dive into modern titles with enhanced graphics and experience fluid video editing and AI-accelerated workflows.

Featuring a fast 512GB NVMe SSD, the system offers swift boot times and rapid game loading. The stunning 15.6-inch Full HD display boasts an ultra-fast 144Hz refresh rate and IPS technology, delivering crisp, blur-free visuals that keep you ahead in fast-paced action games. Finished in a sleek, modern chassis with an advanced thermal design and pre-installed Windows 11, the HP Victus 15 is your ultimate entry-level gaming powerhouse.
